source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance, daily closes (auto-adjusted), EMAs on ~7y history

trendRule.midLong: Up: both EMAs rising ≥1.0% over 21 days. Flat: both within ±1.0%. Down: EMA50 below EMA150 and both falling ≥1.0%. Otherwise mixed.
trendRule.long: EMA200 higher highs / lower lows · 63d windows
trendRule.longLong: Up: EMA200's high and low over the last 63 trading days both above the prior 63-day window. Down: both below. Otherwise flat.
